faq.q: What kind of apps do you build?
faq.a: Business tools: booking systems, client portals, CRMs and dashboards. Apps that replace spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and rented software.

faq.q: Who owns the app and the data?
faq.a: You do. The domain, the data and the accounts are set up in your name, with clear terms on code ownership in the contract.
We build with logins, roles and database rules so each user only sees what they should, and production apps run with daily backups.

faq.q: What does it cost to run?
faq.a: There is a one time build fee and a monthly plan that covers hosting, backups and support. We share the running costs upfront.
